discover.summary: Solar $discover preserves the native non-ingesting discovery contract for the local --from-wiki path: supplied local wiki source evidence produces a ranked, deduped, source-backed shortlist, writes typed boundaries/proof, and does not label the local proof as live provider execution.

acceptance_checks.detail: Native $discover returns a shortlist for anchor/topic/wiki/venue discovery and never auto-ingests papers into the wiki.
Solar shim accepts the native discovery seed flags including --from-wiki, --anchor, --negative, --topic, --venue, --year, --limit, --wiki-root, and --no-citation-expand.
Approved local wiki runtime evidence produces completed literature_discovery.v1 evidence with one candidate, source_channels=['wiki'], and discover_literature_runtime_verified mode.
autosci_discover_final_shortlist_boundary.v1 is final_shortlist_ready with a non-empty candidate list and local wiki source channel.
Local wiki source proof is categorized as native_autosci_replay instead of live_provider, preventing false remote/provider claims.
When provider/network evidence is unavailable, the backend emits inconclusive source evidence rather than fixture or synthetic recommendations.

findings.finding: The local --from-wiki path now has source-backed runtime proof and a completed final shortlist boundary without remote/provider access.
Live Semantic Scholar and Paper Copilot provider-mode audits remain separate optional proof; this assessment does not claim a live provider run.

The top-level skill-run summary may remain inconclusive while the static route is partial; the underlying literature_discovery.v1 action evidence is completed and is the authority for this local proof.
